svg.title: 05 | A pending order can occupy the entry slot
svg.desc: CONCEPTUAL_SCHEMATIC · Fictional order-state example · source-defined EBP-PY-H002 policies The invented A/B/C signal sequence assumes orders remain unfilled and replacement is eligible. It contains no prices, returns or historical timestamps. A live position without BE_APPLIED blocks replacement; both pending policies have no time expiry. Source B21 defines these contracts. No historical price path or contemporaneous counterfactual sequence is shown. H002 arms were separate engine contracts; all four were PARKED. Source contract: One good-till-cancelled pending order blocks later signals; no time expiry. Check active-position eligibility first. A non-BE_APPLIED position blocks replacement. Otherwise supersede old pending and create the new signal order; no time expiry.
